answer: An agent economy can issue each verified participant one tamper-resistant ferrous hardware token whose unclonable magnetic signature answers random challenges during work. Agents accept payments and reputation only after these proofs, while audits compare each token’s history and slash a deposit when identities coordinate fraudulently. A sybil attacker must buy, maintain, and fund a separate token and deposit for every fake account, then spend time earning its reputation, turning mass fabrication into a large capital and operating cost over each voyage as the tide of verified history grows.
